worked.problem: Find the gradient of the straight line through A(-1, 0) and B(2, 9). Draw and label a rise/run triangle.
actions: Plot A(-1, 0) and B(2, 9) on the same axes.
From A to B the horizontal run is 2 − (-1) = 3.
The vertical rise is 9 − (0) = 9.
Gradient = rise ÷ run = 9 ÷ 3 = 3.
Check: moving 3 units right changes y by 9, so the gradient is 3.
worked.check: Check: moving 3 units right changes y by 9, so the gradient is 3.
worked.misconception: Keep axes and ordered-pair positions fixed; reveal each calculated point before joining a line.
